name: LiteLLM Proxy (Self-Hosted)
description: Deploy LiteLLM, the OpenAI-compatible gateway to 100+ model providers with virtual keys, budgets and spend tracking. Runs the official image on ECS Fargate behind a load balancer, with a managed RDS PostgreSQL database and optional Amazon Bedrock access (~$105/mo plus model usage).

cpu.title: Task CPU
cpu.description: Fargate CPU units for the LiteLLM task (1024 = 1 vCPU).

memoryMiB.title: Task Memory (MiB)
memoryMiB.description: Fargate memory for the LiteLLM task. Must suit the CPU: 512 → 1024–4096, 1024 → 2048–8192, 2048 → 4096–8192.

desiredCount.title: Tasks
desiredCount.description: Number of LiteLLM tasks behind the load balancer.

dbMultiAz.title: RDS Multi-AZ
dbMultiAz.description: Keep a standby database in a second availability zone. Doubles the database cost.

bedrockAccess.title: Amazon Bedrock Access
bedrockAccess.description: Let the proxy invoke Amazon Bedrock models in this account with its own role, so Bedrock models can be added without an access key. Invocation is billed to this account.

domainName.title: Custom Domain
domainName.description: Optional custom domain (e.g., llm.example.com). Served over HTTPS with an ACM certificate. Strongly recommended: without it, API keys travel over plain HTTP.

hostedZoneId.title: Route 53 Hosted Zone ID
hostedZoneId.description: Hosted zone for the certificate validation and DNS records.

destroyDataOnDelete.title: Delete Data With the Stack
destroyDataOnDelete.description: Delete the database and the salt key when the stack is deleted instead of keeping a final snapshot. Leave off unless the data is disposable.

estimatedCost.description: ~$105/mo before model usage: Fargate task (1 vCPU, 2 GB) ~$36, NAT gateway ~$33, load balancer ~$20, RDS db.t4g.micro + 20 GB ~$14, Secrets Manager + logs ~$2. Model calls (Bedrock or any other provider) are billed separately by the provider.
